CREATE TABLE {SCHEMA}.AP_Data_v4_dedup_{table_name}_v1 AS
SELECT a.*
FROM {SCHEMA}.AP_Data_v4 a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM l3_dm_db.dim_vendor
    WHERE VENDOR_NAME_ALIAS IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT VENDOR_NAME_ALIAS
        FROM l3_dm_db.dim_vendor
        WHERE Vendor_Name IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT Vendor_Name
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT Vendor_Name AS Vendor_Name
                FROM admin_fee.PO_Data_v1
                WHERE Contract_Number = '{CONTRACT_NAME}'

                UNION ALL

                SELECT DISTINCT Manufacturer_Name AS Vendor_Name
                FROM admin_fee.PO_Data_v1
                WHERE Contract_Number = '{CONTRACT_NAME}'

                UNION ALL

                SELECT DISTINCT Contracted_Supplier AS Vendor_Name
                FROM admin_fee.PO_Data_v1
                WHERE Contract_Number = '{CONTRACT_NAME}'
            ) a
            WHERE Vendor_Name <> 'UNKNOWN'
        )
    )
) b
ON a.Supplier = b.VENDOR_NAME;

create table {SCHEMA}.AP_Data_{table_name}_v1  as  
select * from (
select distinct b.*
 FROM 
 ( select * from {SCHEMA}.PO_Data_{table_name}_v1 ) a
 left join 
{SCHEMA}.AP_Data_v4_dedup_{table_name}_v1   b
 on  trim(coalesce(a.Facility_Product_Description, a.Product_Description)) = 
 trim(LEFT(b.Line_Description, LENGTH(coalesce(a.Facility_Product_Description, a.Product_Description))))

 ) b ;

 `INV_Extended_Spend` , `PO_Base_Price` , `INV_Base_Price` , `PO_Base_Spend_actual` ,
 `INV_Extended_Spend_actual`   ,Matched_Flag

 from ( select  
`PO_seq_no` , `INV_seq_no` , `PO_Number_common` , `PO_Number` , `INV_PO_Number` ,

 `INV_Extended_Spend_actual`   ,Matched_Flag

 from  (SELECT   PO_seq_no  as PO_seq_no,  b.seq_no 
 as INV_seq_no,  coalesce(Transaction_Number , b.External_PO_Number)         
 as PO_Number_common, Transaction_Number  as PO_Number , 
coalesce(b.External_PO_Number,b.Purchase_Orders)  as INV_PO_Number , Transaction_Date  as PO_Date, b.Invoice_Date  as INV_Date ,

 as INV_Quantity , Base_Spend  as PO_Base_Spend , CASE 
    WHEN b.Invoice_Amount  < 0 THEN -ABS(b.Extended_Amount)
    ELSE b.Extended_Amount
END 
 as INV_Extended_Spend , a.Last_Base_Price

 a.Product_Description))))

 ) a   )a
